en-US.name: CalmExam: SAT Math Practice
en-US.subtitle: AP Calculus AB & A-Level Maths
en-US.promotionalText: Unlimited SAT Math and AP Calculus AB practice where every answer is verified. Free, no account, no ads. Set your exam date and get a calm daily plan.
en-US.description:
CalmExam is SAT Math practice that's never wrong, plus AP Calculus AB and A-Level Maths. Every question is generated with its answer computed, so the answer key always matches the question. Pick your exam, set your test date and get a short daily plan, without timers, streak pressure or noise.

BUILT FOR THREE EXAMS
• SAT Math practice for the Digital SAT: linear equations, systems of equations, quadratics, percentages, exponential growth, circles, right triangles and statistics
• AP Calculus AB practice: limits, derivatives (power, product, chain and trig rules), applications of derivatives and integrals
• A-Level Maths practice: algebra, differentiation, integration, logarithms, sequences and series, trigonometry, coordinate geometry and mechanics (SUVAT)

UNLIMITED PRACTICE QUESTIONS
There is no fixed question bank to run out of. Every SAT practice test question and calculus problem is fresh, so you can keep practising a topic until it clicks.

EVERY ANSWER IS VERIFIED
Each question comes from a generator that builds the problem and its answer together, so the answer is computed, not typed in by hand. When you check an answer you see the verified solution, the steps and the common pitfalls that catch most students.

EXPLAIN MY MISTAKE
Got one wrong? Tap "Explain my mistake" for a short, friendly explanation of where your thinking went off track, built on the verified steps. The verified answer always comes first.

A STUDY PLAN UP TO TEST DAY
Take a 5-question placement, tell CalmExam your exam date and how much time you have each day, and get a daily practice set that puts your weakest topics first and runs up to your exam.

CALM BY DESIGN
No countdown clocks, no confetti, no red screens. Wrong answers get a gentle note and a clear next step, so SAT prep and calculus revision feel steady instead of stressful.

FREE AND PRO
Practice is free and unlimited, with no account and no ads. CalmExam Pro adds unlimited "Explain my mistake" (free includes 3 a day) and the full study plan.

CalmExam Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed yearly or monthly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

CalmExam is independent and not affiliated with the College Board or any UK exam board. SAT and AP are trademarks of the College Board.

Privacy Policy: https://calmexam.com/privacy
